scope: Final targeted verification after fixed intrinsic material weights, NPC offcut policy v3, and direct equipment purchase owner assignment fix.

offcutCoverage.note: The same 60 deterministic layouts were checked three times; each run also buys, processes, saves/restores, and migrates a current NPC offcut. This is not 180 distinct deterministic seeds.

uiReview.method: Read-only source review; no additional browser session opened by this subagent.

positive.finding: NPC supplies materials and no upfront working capital are stated; fees and net payment are shown.
Material cost, station/upkeep, incremental appraisal after costs, and actual-sale discount caveat are shown.
Recycling confirmation shows 20% appraisal payout and irreversible inventory removal.

recommendations.finding: Sealed-stone purchase currently states unknown quality/color, but does not explicitly say the purchase can lose principal or that appraisal is not guaranteed resale.
recommendations.suggestion: Add a concise notice on private rough/auction purchase: losses are possible; appraisal is not a guaranteed sale or breakeven price; normal processing failure may consume material.

recommendations.finding: Wholesale confirmation shows offered cash but not acquisition cost or the expected loss from urgent liquidation.
recommendations.suggestion: For complete costBasis records, show recorded item cost, actual cash payout, and their difference. At minimum clarify urgent liquidation is discounted and may not recover purchase cost.
